text:
maya_k: Day-of checklist for SRE candidate (Wed 4pm). Quick asks:
- can someone scribe + capture debrief notes?
- can someone spare 10m to do a quick infra PR review before the interview? PR #412 (small k8s change).
Candidate materials: https://drive.redwood/test-sre-candidate (please confirm access)
Runbook snippet:
```
- 15:45 join candidate room (host)
- 15:55 handoff to panel
- 16:00 interview start
- 16:40 quick break
- 16:50 debrief (assign scribe)
```
Also need rubric point clarification: do we weight "operational debugging" 30% or 40%? cc @elena @samir_patel

samir_patel: I can scribe. Will take notes + put in /hr/debriefs. I'll also be around to moderate rollback question. :thumbsup:

elena: Re: rubric — let's keep operational debugging at 40% for SRE role. Main change request: add "post-mortem reasoning" sub-item under debugging. I'll update template after the interview.

alex_mueller: I can do the 10m PR review at 15:50. Ping me with PR link; if it's small I can do inline comments. Also confirm I have access to candidate drive (I do).

maya_k: Thanks Samir & Alex. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412. It's config tweak + small liveness check. Alex, if you can approve or leave comment before 15:55 that'd be ideal.

priya_m: FYI I'll join debrief to represent hiring panel constraints. One ask: can we remind interviewers to mute notifications and use the score rubric doc? https://docs.redwood/rubrics/sre-panel

ops_bot: Reminder scheduled: "SRE interview — candidate prep" at 15:30 for channel #people-ops and pinging @samir_patel @alex_mueller.

samir_patel: Got drive access confirmed. Will start scribe doc at 15:45 and drop a link in thread.

elena: I'll add the "post-mortem reasoning" bullet now. Quick note: please don't score on "systems design" unless candidate shows system-level tradeoffs — keep focused.

maya_k: Great. Small follow-ups — Samir, can you also capture any test-case prompts we used? Alex, if you leave comments on PR, add a quick note "candidate-ops infra PR reviewed pre-interview". That helps audit.

alex_mueller: Will do. Adding comment now. :white_check_mark:

maya_k: Thanks everyone — see you at 15:30 prep. If anything blocks access DM me.
